cause: Replacing the operator role assignment invalidates the schedule activation made under the previous assignment; confirmed on 2026-10-23 01:10Z by a replace alone (no release), after which the 01:11 tick was refused deny_tier and the schedule suspended. Re-activating after any re-approval resolves it (lab/reapprove.py).
fix: Operations procedure: re-approve only when the assignment is not active, and re-activate the schedule after any replace (lab/reapprove.py); Overview shows a suspended schedule with Re-activate.
byDesign: Release f7fd9e6d added protected routes (authorization.yaml), and the next tick at 22:32Z was suspended; Overview now shows that state and re-activates on the owner's click.
correction: The first explanation (the Git commit pin in the schedule fingerprint) is a real defect for git registry installs and is fixed in oshal-kernel PR 81, but this lab installs from a staged local source, so it was not the cause here. The before/after release pair below shows releases that did and did not need a re-approval.
